description: Dart class 'NetworkRepository' providing network and websocket operations such as fetching user profiles, connecting to real-time services, disconnecting, and streaming messages, used as part of a Flutter app's data layer.

classes.name: NetworkRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing network and WebSocket interactions for fetching profiles and real-time communication.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile using the API client.

methods.name: connectRealtime
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and joins a lobby for real-time notifications.

methods.name: disconnectRealtime
methods.description: Disconnects from the WebSocket real-time service.

methods.name: realtimeMessages
methods.description: Provides a stream of decoded real-time messages received via WebSocket.
